narrative.overview: A semiconductor reference document that happens to be a website: serif headings that state a finding, sans-serif body at a comfortable measure, monospace for anything a machine produced. Dark, because the imagery it carries is photographic and dark. The restraint is the argument: every figure carries the kind of evidence behind it, and claims that failed verification are printed with the reason they were withdrawn, so a visual system that shouted would undercut the content.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink ground, warm copper accent, one cool teal reserved for the safe state
Serif display over sans body over monospace labels: three voices, never four
Rules and type carry structure; shadows appear only on overlays and on hover
Evidence grade printed next to figures, not implied
Reduced motion is a first-class path, not a fallback

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Copper is the only accent. A new state gets a new shape, weight or position, not a new hue. Teal is the single exception and it means safe, nothing else.

rules.name: The Named Colour Rule
rules.body: A colour used more than once is a token. The codebase holds 1,065 literal colour values against 1,209 token references across 524 distinct literals, including 140 distinct near-blacks for 293 uses. That is drift, not a ramp.

rules.name: The Alpha Is Not A Colour Rule
rules.body: #d4a36e1f is copper at 12%, not a separate colour. Express it from the token so a change to copper reaches every place copper is implied.

rules.name: The Verdict Heading Rule
rules.body: A heading states the finding, not the topic. A heading that ends in a question mark has not been written yet.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace means a machine produced it. Prose never sets itself in monospace for texture.

rules.name: The Joined Quantity Rule
rules.body: A number and its unit are joined by a non-breaking space, and numerals are set as tabular figures.

rules.name: The No Halo Rule
rules.body: A zero-offset coloured box-shadow is banned and gated in the build. A shadow has an offset, or it is not a shadow.

rules.name: The Resting Flatness Rule
rules.body: A surface that is part of the page carries no shadow. A shadow means the element is above the page, or is responding to a pointer.

rules.name: The No Side Tab Rule
rules.body: A thick coloured border on one edge of a panel is banned. State is carried by the whole frame, the background tint and the label.

dos: Do state a finding in a heading, and print the evidence grade next to a figure.
Do use one of the fourteen named colours. A colour used twice is a token.
Do join a number to its unit with a non-breaking space, and set numerals as tabular figures.
Do enumerate the properties a transition animates.
Do give every scroll-driven surface a complete resting state, and a reduced-motion path.
Do keep body text inside the 64ch measure.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue. Teal means safe and nothing else.
Don't use transition: all, a zero-offset coloured halo, or a coloured stripe down one edge of a panel. All three are gated in the build.
Don't write a new near-black. There are already 140 of them and that is the system's one real defect.
Don't set prose in monospace, or a machine-produced value in the serif.
Don't put a number on the page that no source document carries.
